verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no region or data-residency selection for Cactus's hosted platform, which handles uploaded bytes, training-data generation and fine-tuning. On-device inference ('no data leaving the device') and local LoRA fine-tuning on your own hardware are adjacent privacy features, not a choice of storage region, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
